scope: Hamburg’s Heiligengeistfeld Flakturm IV on Feldstraße, in its 2006 media-bunker form before the 2022–2024 green roof and hotel conversion.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Identifies the 1942–1943 Feldstraße bunker, its geographic setting and the later conversion.
Identifies the original concrete bunker and distinguishes the new 58 m roof additions.
The conversion team describes the earlier mass as having roughly a 70 by 70 m ground area and 40 m height.
